GPT-6 Astra launched overnight with one of the wildest benchmark tables I've seen. Its 99.9% ARC-AGI-3 score has people claiming AGI is here. The test measures whether an agent can explore an unfamiliar world, learn its rules and act efficiently. Astra's biggest practical jump is computer use.

ARC Prize's standard harness gave Astra 62.7%. OpenAI's Provider Adapter produced the 99.9% result by preserving reasoning state and compacting long conversations. The video also covers a week-long Manhattan build in Unreal Engine, Apple Park in Blender and an interactive Library of Alexandria.

I also cover the messy rollout, who gets access first and the banked Codex resets OpenAI is giving paid ChatGPT users while they wait. If Astra is in your account, give it a large computer-use or coding job. An email rewrite will tell you almost nothing about this model.
